clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, a summons carries a young priest from the Park to the Cathedral of Light. Nara Meideros sends you to High Priestess Laurena for further instruction.

In Stormwind’s Park, Nara Meideros keeps faith with Elune. The city’s spiritual guides share ties across their different traditions. When the Cathedral seeks a promising student, Nara sends you across the canals with quiet encouragement. The message brings good tidings, not cause for alarm.

At the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, you report to High Priestess Laurena. One of Stormwind’s senior clerical leaders, she guides young acolytes beyond their first prayers. Laurena teaches the sacred invocation called Desperate Prayer, a personal plea for divine aid. It can mend grievous wounds in an instant when a servant of the Light stands near death.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, traveler. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... As though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.
Elune be with you, good traveler.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you've arrived, friend. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
